summary_1line: Hanuman secretly observes Sita in the Ashoka grove surrounded by grotesque demoness guards while lamenting her misery and devotion to Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman hides among the branches of a tree under the moonlight, watching sorrowful Sita surrounded by grotesque demoness guards in the Ashoka grove.
A circle of monstrous titan women with animal heads, twisted limbs, and weapons sit around the tree where Sita stands in tattered clothes.
Dust-covered Sita, thin and grief-stricken like a fallen star, sits beneath an Ashoka tree while the moonlight falls softly on her.
